title: Rules Frontmatter Contract v1.0
description: YAML frontmatter discipline for every rules/*.md file (spec §8 + ADR-013). Locks the contract: name + status + applies_to identify the rule's scope; spec_section + related cross-link to design + adjacent rules; applied_to_skills (optional) lists production skill consumers for content rules. Validated by tests/rules/test_frontmatter.py + glossary-audit skill on every commit. Resolves H-A v1.4-deep-audit-fix Tier 2 Step 1 (4-pattern frontmatter drift across 20 rules).

schema_version.description: Schema version this rule frontmatter conforms to (rules/schema-versioning-discipline.md). Optional in v1.0 (backwards-compat for 20 rules written pre-v1.4-deep-audit-fix); strongly recommended for new rules. Future major bump (2.0) may require it.

name.description: Human-readable rule title; used in cross-rule references and glossary lookups.

status.description: Lifecycle marker. enforced = production-locked, glossary-audit fires on violation; deprecated = scheduled removal; draft = pre-spec, not enforced; experimental = under evaluation.

applies_to.description: Scope of enforcement. plugin = engine repo (read-only motor); workspace = project state repo; skill = SKILL.md author obligation.

spec_section.description: Anchor in design.md or ADR (e.g. '§8.4', '§9 + ADR-022/026'). Cross-links rule to its authoritative origin.

related.description: Adjacent rule slugs (without .md extension) for SSOT navigation.

applied_to_skills.description: Optional list of production skill slugs this rule constrains. Used by content-* rules to declare downstream consumers (new-blog, revise-content, etc.). Replaces the legacy field name 'applied_to' (renamed in v1.4-deep-audit-fix Tier 2).

since.description: Date the rule was introduced (ISO 8601 date).

supersedes.description: Slug of the rule this one replaces, or 'none'. Aligns with ADR archive chain convention.

source.description: Origin document path (e.g. spec doc + Phase decision matrix); useful for migration tracking.
